about: Inputs for the side-view simulation. Ground and weather are observed; the simulation built on them is modelled.
ground_note: Kind from Landsat bands: water if NDWI > 0.05, vegetation if NDVI > 0.3, else bare. Surface temperature at the satellite's overpass (overpass_utc, hours UTC).

estimated-1991.station: estimated for the area near the lake (Hoyerswerda, 8 km) from 00880 Cottbus
estimated-1991.station_name: Near the lake, estimated from Cottbus
estimated-1991.method: Cottbus reading plus the average Hoyerswerda-minus-Cottbus difference in 2010-2024 at the same hour, within a month of the date, in the same cloud and wind class. See scripts/estimate_weather.py.
